profile.reading: This record is named Noovle in this registry, and its coordinates match the city of Bologna, Italy, one of the 16 data centers the operator own most recent published network overview lists across Italy. Noovle S.p.A. is a TIM Enterprise brand and Societa Benefit, based in Milan, that manages what it describes as the most extensive certified data center network across Italy, with more than 100 certifications combined across the network. No facility specific address, capacity, or square footage for this Bologna site is published in sourcing reachable this session. Noovle's own network overview names its facility here plainly "Data Center Bologna," one of 16 sites in a network that also includes four in the Turin area (Centro, Ovest, Nord, Sud), four in the Milan area (Nord, Sud, Ovest, Est), and Padova, three Rome-area sites (Nord, Sud, Ovest), and Firenze. All 16 sites, including this one, carry ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 27001 certification per the operator's own materials, though Bologna is not among the select sites the operator additionally lists as TIER IV or LEED certified (that distinction applies to the separate Roma Ovest facility tracked elsewhere in this registry). Noovle S.p.A. itself is a TIM Enterprise brand and Societa Benefit headquartered in Milan, positioned as Italy's most extensive certified data center network; TIM (Telecom Italia) is Italy's former state telephone monopoly, privatized in the 1990s, and Noovle represents its modern enterprise cloud and data center division. No street address, square footage, or MW capacity figure for this Bologna site specifically was located in sourcing reachable this session, consistent with the operator's general practice of publishing network-level rather than per-site technical detail on its public pages. Fresh research this session, using web search tools unavailable in the prior exhausted pass, locates this facility at Via della Centralinista 3 in Bologna, confirmed by data center directory listings that match the operators own Noovle DC Bologna naming. The building is reported to run at a Power Usage Effectiveness below 1.3, a level of efficiency Noovle has highlighted elsewhere in its Italian network, including a full LEED Gold certification awarded to its Milano Est facility in August 2022, a distinction Noovle describes as held by only 68 data centers worldwide. No square footage or megawatt capacity figure for the Bologna building specifically was published on any source checked this session, and none is asserted here.

reading.body:
Noovle operates one of 16 certified data centers across Italy under the TIM Enterprise brand, located in Bologna, but publishes no specific address or capacity data for this facility.

The operator markets itself around certification density rather than scale metrics. Across its network, Noovle lists more than 100 combined certifications, suggesting a strategy built on compliance and compliance stacking rather than published megawatt counts or construction footprint. This contrasts with how many data center operators in other markets lead with power capacity or facility size.

For compute infrastructure planning, this Bologna site remains a blank: its power draw, cooling architecture, and land footprint are not disclosed. The data confirms a facility exists and is operated by TIM Enterprise's Noovle division, but tells nothing about whether it constrains or enables AI workload placement in the region. Italy's grid constraints and power costs are knowable from other sources, but this specific facility's contribution to or draw on those constraints cannot be estimated from published material.
